channel.title: Wire — JavaScript
channel.description: JavaScript from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
item.description: We are releasing cf, our new command-line tool that mirrors the entire Cloudflare API and supports programmatic TypeScript configuration. We are also open-sourcing Forge, our internal SDK generator. (2 sources: cloudflare, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Four months of VoidZero at Cloudflare: making the open-source JavaScript toolchain faster for all humans and agents
item.description: Since joining Cloudflare, VoidZero has delivered more than 80 releases that drastically speed up JavaScript compilation, linting, and testing. (2 sources: cloudflare, javascriptweekly)

item.title: The JavaScript Pun: tagged template literal
Improving site performance by shipping more CSS
item.description: How we fully migrated github.com away from CSS-in-JS. The post Improving site performance by shipping more CSS appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (3 sources: githubblog, javascriptweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Build products that help people build their lives
item.description: Put your skills towards creating the products and tools that redefine investing at an instutition with a startup mindset and a Fortune 500 foundation. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: Node.js Built-ins That Replaced npm Packages
item.description: Twelve Node.js built-ins that replace axios, nodemon, dotenv, jest, chalk, glob and more, with their stability in Node 24 and one gotcha each. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, nodeweekly)

item.title: EmDash 1.0: the stable CMS with a secure plugin registry
item.description: EmDash 1.0 is a stable, open source CMS built for Astro, with agent-friendly workflows, secure sandboxed plugins, and a decentralized registry that keeps publishers in control. (2 sources: cloudflare, javascriptweekly)

item.title: How Anthropic Made Claude's Apps 3x Faster in Two Weeks
item.description: Inside our performance sprint: the benchmarks Claude built, the loop each Slack thread ran, and the guardrails that let us ship 3,000 changes safely. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: Vite+ 1.0: One CLI for Your Entire JavaScript Toolchain
item.description: Vite+ 1.0 is here. One CLI manages your runtime, package manager, and frontend toolchain. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: latest TC39 meeting
item.description: TC39 meeting agendas. Contribute to tc39/agendas development by creating an account on GitHub. (1 source: javascriptweekly)

item.title: Fake Express Packages on npm Spread a Linux Worm
item.description: Nine fake Express and React packages on npm run a Linux worm at install time. It installs a Tor backdoor and spreads through SSH, AUR packages, and npm tokens. (1 source: lobsters)
